messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images, using the front and back reference views to match the hairstyle shape accurately. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the result of edit 1, then use that video as the starting point for the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's hairstyle to the one shown in the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, raises one arm to touch her hair, then turns slightly to the side while keeping a hand near her head.","camera":"Static, low-angle full-body shot from behind the character.","clothing":"A short, long-sleeved dress with a blue, white, and black geometric pattern and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Light blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair styled into two high buns on top of the head.","identity":"A slender 3D-rendered female character with a low-cut back dress and red sneakers, shown from behind.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk with a Ferris wheel on the left, a lit carousel structure on the right, and a paved ground."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's short blonde hair was restyled into two high buns on top of the head, matching the reference hairstyle. The blonde color, dress, red sneakers, amusement-park scene, camera angle, and body motion remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's hairstyle to the reference style, using only the reference for hair shape while preserving identity, hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects.
uncertain: Whether the buns and surrounding hair match the reference shape exactly from all angles, since the character is mostly shown from behind and at a distance.
